extract: Jio Platforms Ltd., the digital services arm of Reliance Industries, is said to have attracted more than $20 billion in bids for what could be India’s biggest-ever initial public offering (IPO), Bloomberg reported, citing people familiar with the matter.

extract: Infosys Chairman Nandan Nilekani has dismissed fears that artificial intelligence will eliminate jobs, arguing that while AI is automating tasks such as coding, it will create demand for new skills and more work in enterprise transformation.

Nilekani, one of Infosys’ seven co-founders, expects new roles to emerge around making AI systems safe and reliable.
